entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Shortly after my return from Wehlen..."
entries.dialogueText: Shortly after my return from Wehlen, I was told that my uncle wanted to speak to me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The door to my chambers swung open..."
entries.dialogueText: The door to my chambers swung open as Titus let him in.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Romus. My king.""
entries.dialogueText: "Romus. My king."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Yet I cannot help but wonder wheth..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yet I cannot help but wonder whether this triumph had to come at such a great cost."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I begged you with all my heart --..."
entries.dialogueText: "I begged you with all my heart -- as your uncle and your Grand Vizier. And you refused to listen."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Despite the fact that my son was p..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite the fact that my son was proven innocent, you are keen on letting Ricardus rot in a cell..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Despite my entreaties, you insiste..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite my entreaties, you insisted on sending my son to Wehlen..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Ricardus might have erred, but he..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ricardus might have erred, but he is still a Toras. Your flesh and blood, for God's sake!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He is a traitor, Hugo. We've alrea..."
entries.dialogueText: "He is a traitor, Hugo. We've already been through this."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I did what I had to do to get Zill..."
entries.dialogueText: "I did what I had to do to get Zille back. Rico was a necessary sacrifice so that millions more Rizians could live in peace and freedom."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am sorry, Hugo. There is nothing..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am sorry, Hugo. There is nothing I can do about it now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are speaking to the King, Hugo..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are speaking to the King, Hugo. Please lower your voice."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""He's your cousin, for God's sake!..."
entries.dialogueText: "He's your cousin, for God's sake! Your flesh and blood!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I could see him struggling to stay..."
entries.dialogueText: I could see him struggling to stay calm.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We've already been through this.""
entries.dialogueText: "We've already been through this."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""How could you let President Smolak..."
entries.dialogueText: "How could you let President Smolak take him? I explicitly asked you to respect Rico's dignity."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He stopped himself and cleared his..."
entries.dialogueText: He stopped himself and cleared his throat.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Your Majesty...""
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You know how much I've done for th..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know how much I've done for the sake of the Crown. For our family."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""What end goal can justify subjecti..."
entries.dialogueText: "What end goal can justify subjecting your own cousin to the barbaric punishment of the Wehzeks? Have you so little faith in Rizian justice?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Barbaric? Ricardus is royalty. The..."
entries.dialogueText: "Barbaric? Ricardus is royalty. They're probably feeding him grapes over there right now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am terribly sorry. I'll miss Ric..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am terribly sorry. I'll miss Rico just as much as you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It was a decision borne of necessi..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was a decision borne of necessity, not desire. The negative consequences of denying Wehlen's request would have been far worse."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I believe I have said enough on th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe I have said enough on this subject."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Think of my loyalty, Romus. Of my..."
entries.dialogueText: "Think of my loyalty, Romus. Of my service to the Crown. Is this the price? My son's head on a foreign pike?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I swore an oath to give my life in..."
entries.dialogueText: "I swore an oath to give my life in service to this kingdom. And I do not intend to falter in my sacred duty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked at me with fury in his ey..."
entries.dialogueText: He looked at me with fury in his eyes.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't be so dramatic.""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't be so dramatic."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your loyalty has never been in que..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your loyalty has never been in question, nor will it ever be. This pains me deeply, Hugo. Believe me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What's done is done. The Crown mus..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's done is done. The Crown must often make choices that wound us personally for the greater good of the kingdom."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The longer you keep going on like..."
entries.dialogueText: "The longer you keep going on like this, the more I'm beginning to doubt that loyalty."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You don't mean that.""
entries.dialogueText: "You don't mean that."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked at me with fury in his ey..."
entries.dialogueText: He looked at me with fury in his eyes.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Are you serious?""
entries.dialogueText: "Are you serious?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He let out a deep sigh."
entries.dialogueText: He let out a deep sigh.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He was holding his golden pin, The..."
entries.dialogueText: He was holding his golden pin, The Vizier's Star -- the official symbol of his authority as the Grand Vizier -- in his hands. He gripped it tightly.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I cannot bear this, Romus...""
entries.dialogueText: "I cannot bear this, Romus..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I cannot in good conscience contin..."
entries.dialogueText: "I cannot in good conscience continue my duties as Grand Vizier, knowing my son has been thrown to the wolves."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I need some time on my own. I need..."
entries.dialogueText: "I need some time on my own. I need to leave the capital."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What do you mean, you're leaving?""
entries.dialogueText: "What do you mean, you're leaving?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You can't quit. You're fired.""
entries.dialogueText: "You can't quit. You're fired."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You cannot just abandon your dutie..."
entries.dialogueText: "You cannot just abandon your duties, Hugo."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If that is your wish, Uncle, I wil..."
entries.dialogueText: "If that is your wish, Uncle, I will not stop you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And where will you go?""
entries.dialogueText: "And where will you go?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I will go back home, to Monqiz. It..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will go back home, to Monqiz. It has been too long, anyway."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I cannot continue to serve you in..."
entries.dialogueText: "I cannot continue to serve you in the same capacity anymore."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He walked up to my desk and placed..."
entries.dialogueText: He walked up to my desk and placed his pin on it.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""For the good of the Crown, I must.""
entries.dialogueText: "For the good of the Crown, I must."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I cannot stay here, Romus.""
entries.dialogueText: "I cannot stay here, Romus."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I shall assist Vina once she moves..."
entries.dialogueText: "I shall assist Vina once she moves to Valenqiris, if Her Highness accepts my help."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I shall assist Duke Hubertus with..."
entries.dialogueText: "I shall assist Duke Hubertus with his duties, if His Grace accepts my help."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I will do what I can for our house..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will do what I can for our house and our province. But I will no longer involve myself in the affairs of the capital."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""It pains me deeply, but I must let..."
entries.dialogueText: "It pains me deeply, but I must let go of my title and responsibilities."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""There.""
entries.dialogueText: "There."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He knelt in front of me."
entries.dialogueText: He knelt in front of me.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""It was an honor to serve you, King..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was an honor to serve you, King Romus Toras, the First of His Name."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your departure is tantamount to be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your departure is tantamount to betrayal. I will no longer be able to trust you after this. You understand that, right?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm warning you, Hugo. Don't think..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm warning you, Hugo. Don't think about doing anything questionable."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There is no need for that. Stand u..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is no need for that. Stand up. You are still family."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I am disappointed you would think..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am disappointed you would think that of me, my nephew."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""My loyalty to the Kingdom has neve..."
entries.dialogueText: "My loyalty to the Kingdom has never once wavered."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Glovurius axa Rizia.""
entries.dialogueText: "Glovurius axa Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And it was an honor to have your g..."
entries.dialogueText: "And it was an honor to have your guidance."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He stood up."
entries.dialogueText: He stood up.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He bowed his head and left the room..."
entries.dialogueText: He bowed his head and left the room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo would have to be watched close..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo would have to be watched closely from now on.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're just going to let him do th..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sorry. He's forgotten all of the t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry. He's forgotten all of the training Rico gave him."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "On hearing his son's name, Hugo shu..."
entries.dialogueText: On hearing his son's name, Hugo shuddered involuntarily. He pushed Bruno aside and stood before me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo didn't answer. He pushed Bruno..."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo had a numb look in his eyes as..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo had a numb look in his eyes as he came to stand before me.
